title: Antarctic ozone hole confirmed
description: British Antarctic Survey scientists published evidence of severe seasonal ozone depletion over Antarctica, triggering the treaty process that followed.

title: Chernobyl nuclear disaster
description: A reactor explosion in Soviet Ukraine became the worst nuclear accident in history and reshaped public attitudes to nuclear power.

title: Montreal Protocol signed
description: Nations agreed to phase out ozone-depleting substances in what became one of the most widely ratified environmental treaties.

title: The World Wide Web is proposed
description: Tim Berners-Lee circulated a proposal at CERN for a hypertext information system, the design that became the web.

title: Fall of the Berlin Wall
description: The opening of the Berlin Wall began the end of the Cold War division of Europe.

title: Hubble Space Telescope launched
description: Hubble began returning images that reshaped astronomy and public understanding of the universe.

title: The first website goes public
description: CERN put the first website online, making the web publicly accessible.

title: Apartheid ends in South Africa
description: South Africa held its first fully democratic election, ending decades of legislated racial segregation.

title: Dolly the sheep is cloned
description: The first mammal cloned from an adult somatic cell opened a new era in genetics and bioethics.

title: Deep Blue defeats a world chess champion
description: IBM's Deep Blue beat Garry Kasparov in a full match, the first such defeat of a reigning champion by a computer.

title: Construction of the ISS begins
description: The first modules of the International Space Station were launched, starting a continuous human presence in orbit.

title: World population reaches six billion
description: The United Nations marked the global population passing six billion people.

title: First draft of the human genome
description: Researchers announced a working draft of the human genome sequence.

title: Wikipedia is launched
description: A freely editable encyclopedia began, growing into one of the most visited reference sources in the world.

title: Human Genome Project completed
description: The international effort to sequence the human genome was declared essentially complete.

title: Facebook launches
description: Social networking began its shift from niche websites to global mass communication.

title: YouTube launches
description: Online video moved from specialist hobby to everyday media.

title: Pluto reclassified as a dwarf planet
description: The International Astronomical Union adopted a formal definition of a planet, reclassifying Pluto.

title: The first iPhone
description: The modern smartphone arrived, putting the internet in most people's pockets over the following decade.

title: Global financial crisis
description: A banking collapse triggered the deepest global recession since the 1930s.

title: First synthetic bacterial cell
description: Researchers created a bacterial cell controlled by a chemically synthesised genome.

title: World population reaches seven billion
description: The United Nations marked the global population passing seven billion people.

title: Higgs boson discovered
description: CERN announced the discovery of a particle consistent with the Higgs boson, completing the Standard Model.

title: India certified polio-free
description: The World Health Organization certified the South-East Asia region as free of wild poliovirus.

title: Paris Agreement adopted
description: Nearly every country agreed a framework to limit global temperature rise.

title: Gravitational waves detected
description: LIGO announced the first direct observation of gravitational waves, confirming a century-old prediction.

title: First image of a black hole
description: The Event Horizon Telescope released the first direct image of a black hole's shadow.

title: COVID-19 declared a pandemic
description: The World Health Organization declared a pandemic, beginning the largest global public health disruption in generations.

title: First mRNA vaccines authorised
description: mRNA vaccines moved from research to mass deployment within a year of the virus being sequenced.

title: James Webb Space Telescope launched
description: The largest space telescope ever built launched, designed to observe the earliest galaxies.

title: Generative AI reaches the public
description: The release of ChatGPT brought large language models to mainstream use.

title: World population reaches eight billion
description: The United Nations marked the global population passing eight billion people.

title: COVID-19 emergency phase ends
description: The World Health Organization ended the public health emergency of international concern.

title: First commercial spacewalk
description: The Polaris Dawn crew conducted the first spacewalk carried out by a private mission.
